human.name: Human
human.description: Adaptable and ambitious, humans settle every climate and trade with every people. What they lack in innate gifts they make up for with sheer versatility.

elf.name: Elf
elf.description: Long-lived and graceful, elves remember the world before the cities. Keen senses and an old bond with the weave of magic make them peerless archers and enchanters.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.description: Stout delvers of stone and metal. Dwarven clans measure wealth in craft and grudges alike; their smiths are legend and their stubbornness more so.

orc.name: Orc
orc.description: Fierce, proud and tribal, orcs value strength and honour above gold. Their war-chants carry for miles and their blood runs hot in battle.

halfling.name: Halfling
halfling.description: Small, cheerful and far braver than they look. Halflings love good food and quiet hills, yet their luck and nimble fingers take them into every adventure.

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.description: Wiry, clever and endlessly inventive, goblins scavenge, tinker and haggle. Big ears miss nothing; long noses smell every opportunity.

sylvan.name: Sylvan
sylvan.description: Folk of the old forests, sylvans have bark-patterned skin and hair of living leaves that turns with their seasons. They speak with trees and heal with sap and song.

drakeborn.name: Drakeborn
drakeborn.description: Scaled descendants of dragon-blood, horned and tailed, with slit-pupiled eyes that glow like embers. Proud warriors and fire-callers.

umbral.name: Umbral
umbral.description: Pale dwellers of the underworld whose veins shimmer with captured shadow. Their glowing eyes pierce darkness and their whispers bend minds.

giantkin.name: Giantkin
giantkin.description: Towering folk with giant blood, slow to anger and terrible when roused. Their skin often bears the hue of the mountains they came from.
